lib/store.js.reason: Single SQLite persistence layer: transactions, schema, migrations, archive, search index and metrics must share one connection and one schema version. Split design is tracked in docs/store-split-plan.md.

client.js.reason: Single client entry: slot registration, panel routing and view components share one bundle boundary.

lib/web-page-script.js.reason: Single browser script injected as one <script> block: search, tabs, graph, settings and locale share one DOM/state closure. CSS and HTML shell are already split; splitting the script itself would add cross-template coupling without a bundler, and the page is served unchanged.
